gen-gf-oxanium-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Sofia Sans Condensed is friendly and contemporary, with a big x-height and plain strokes that carry no calligraphic shading. Oxanium shouts in display letters while the body keeps its voice down.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-voces: Marker-traced, tall and confident, Oxanium draws every letter in one unbroken line. Voces carries lightly modulated strokes with no harsh thin spots, which feels gentler beside that marker-line heading.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-winky-rough: Bent-tubing swagger: Oxanium looks shaped from a single length of tubing. Winky Rough sits low and nearly level with the capitals, so paragraphs feel compact and steady rather than showy.
gen-gf-oxanium-sora: Precise and geometric, Sora turns every corner without a hint of pressure swell. Sora keeps paragraphs moving with moderate lowercase, a quieter foil to the tall letters of Oxanium.
gen-gf-oxanium-space-grotesk: Oxanium draws every letter in a single unbroken monoline stroke. Space Grotesk, a geometric sans with moderate lowercase and open counters, keeps lengthy text quiet beside that tall heading.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-amulya: Scattered letters, lowercase as loud as capitals: that is Paprika. Amulya, a modern sans with generous gaps in its curves and moderate lowercase, keeps lengthy text unhurried by comparison.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-plein: Scattered and loud, Paprika fills the line with lowercase built like capitals. Paprika is best at grabbing attention, Plein at staying reliable and clean with a clear channel into each round letter.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-arsenal: Arsenal keeps its lowercase close to cap height, tight and approachable. Paprika is the one for scattered, attention-grabbing display, while the sans body handles the modest weight shifts of steady text.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-cal-sans: Expressive Paprika scatters its lowercase across the line like capitals, while Cal Sans, a sans-serif, keeps one stroke width throughout. Short ascenders and a tall x-height keep its text compact.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-days-one: Days One reads approachable, spaced like rungs on a rope ladder. Paprika is the expressive showpiece, loud and scattered, while the sans body simply fills the line without fuss.
